notes.title: Version 0.5.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
I'm excited to share the release of 0.5.0 update! It features major performance improvements, new content, and critical bug fixes to Xavian! This release marks a major milestone in development as we continue to refine the player experience as we get closer to the full 1.0 release 😁 Now, without further ado the patch notes: 

[h2]Technical & Performance Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upgraded the game engine to Unity 6.0.,
[*] Optimized performance across all platforms:
[*] Removed Roughness & Ambient Occlusion Maps from all NPCs and Enemies.,
[*] Combined multiple maps into a single Mask Map for efficiency.,
[*] Reduced total number of shaders and texture assets.,
[*] Dropped support for Intel-based macOS systems (Apple Silicon still supported)
[/list]
[h2]Cutscenes & Cinematics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cutscenes are now character-specific depending on whether you play as Hathor or Xavian.,
[*] Updated visuals and new audio/SFX in the Arena
[*] Fixed bug where conversations could be skipped unintentionally.,
[*] New opening cutscene added for both characters in Scene 02.,
[*] Cutscene transitions into gameplay are now smoother and more seamless.,
[/list]
[h2]NPCs & Conversations[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added 2 new NPCs: Hippo and Rhino.,
[*] Overhauled locomotion and animations for all 8 NPCs
[*] Improved walking, talking, and idle animations.
[*] During conversations: NPCs now correctly enter their talking animations.,
[*] Dynamic camera framing keeps both player and NPCs in view throughout the interaction
[/olist]
[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Tutorial & Camera[/h3]
[list]
[*] Streamlined the camera control tutorial to be more intuitive and clear
[/list]
[h2]Rail Grinding System[/h2]
[list]
[*] Switching between rails
[*] Dismounting from a rail
[*] Camera rotation while grinding
[/list]
[h2]Scene 02 – Rail Mission[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple soft-lock bugs during the rail missions
[*] Soft-lock after starting the Rail Mission
[*] Soft-lock after restarting the mission
[*] UI-related soft-locks when either succeeding or failing the mission
[/list]
[h2]Boss Fight (Scene 01)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented a new camera system that locks onto both the player and boss.,
[*] Added two distinct phases to the Boss Fight for a more dynamic encounter.,
[/list]
[h2]Environment & Level Design for Scene 02[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new food stand props for livelier areas
[*] Expanded Rail Grind routes for more traversal variety
[*] Improved lighting and shadows with the Unity 6.0 upgrade
[/list]
